200.description: Stream of frames up to `done` or `error`.

estimated.description: `true` when the provider did not return a count and the cost was ESTIMATED. The number is worth less, and whoever consumes it needs to be able to say so.

modelName.description: Only on the `done`/`final` frame — name of the model that generated the response (finding from problem 2). `null` when the turn failed before resolving a model.

403.description: Service token missing or different from the shared one.

404.description: Session, project, or resource not found.
